worldcombat.skill.bugbite.summary: Bite the target; if it holds a Berry, tear it off and eat it on the spot, taking the Berry's effect for yourself - healing, a status cure, or a stat boost. A close bite that absorbs more once chewed.
worldcombat.skill.bugbite.use.0: Bite and eat the target's Berry
worldcombat.skill.bugbite.use.1: Turn the target's Berry into your own healing or boost
worldcombat.skill.bugbite.description.0: The bite deals about %1$s Bug contact damage with a %2$s block hit radius; the target's Defence, type match-up and criticals settle on impact.
worldcombat.skill.bugbite.description.1: Lunge up to %1$s blocks along your aim at %2$s blocks per tick; a landed hit shoves the target about %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.bugbite.description.2: A torn-off Berry is chewed for %1$s seconds at %2$s times effect, giving off about %3$s crumbs.
worldcombat.skill.bugbite.devour.on: Devour on: longer chewing, absorption x1.25 and one extra stat stage, at the cost of a x0.9 hit.
worldcombat.skill.bugbite.devour.off: Devour off: absorption x0.8 and a x1.08 hit; a heavier bite with a shallower absorb.
worldcombat.skill.bugbite.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.bugbite.growth.0: At level %1$s, the bite power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.bugbite.growth.1: At level %1$s, the bite power rises to %2$s and absorption to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.bugbite.preference.dev: On: longer chewing, absorption x1.25, one extra stat stage, hit x0.9. Off: absorption x0.8, hit x1.08.
Only lunge in within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
On: it will leave its station under a hold order to lunge in. Off: it only does so when the target is already in reach.
On: only used when the target carries a Berry, as a dedicated eater. Off: bare-handed targets are bitten as ordinary contact attacks.
world_combat.move.bugbite.text.spike: Pricked by a spike in the Berry
world_combat.move.bugbite.text.none: The pulp had no special effect
